frameworks.name: India Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025

findings.title: Undeclared personal data category
findings.detail: Activity 'repayments' processes Location data in code, but the record does not declare it.
findings.fix: Declare the category on the activity (and update the notice and legal basis), or remove the data from the code.

findings.title: Undeclared processor / third party
findings.detail: Activity 'repayments' sends Contact, Location data to Mixpanel, which is not a declared processor.
findings.fix: Add the processor with country and contract reference, link it to the activity, or remove the integration.

findings.title: Personal data written to logs
findings.detail: Contact data is written to logs in activity 'repayments' (1 location(s)).
findings.fix: Remove or mask the field before logging, or record a time-boxed exception with a reason.
